summary: Implemented comprehensive quality gates to prevent async/await bugs

changesApplied.reason: Enables static type checking to catch missing await calls before commit
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: LOW - Only affects development environment, no runtime impact

changesApplied.reason: Configures pyright to treat missing await as ERROR (not warning), blocking commits with async bugs
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: CRITICAL - Enforces async/await correctness at commit time for server/routes and server/db/operations

changesApplied.reason: Runs type checker on every commit, catches missing awaits BEFORE code review
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: CRITICAL - Blocks local commits with type errors, prevents async bugs from reaching CI
changesApplied.hookBehavior: Runs after black/isort, before commitizen. Fails fast on type errors.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added 'Run Type Checking' step before tests, changed pytest to --cov-fail-under=80
changesApplied.reason: CI now fails if: (1) type errors exist OR (2) coverage drops below 80%
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: CRITICAL - Prevents merges with type errors or insufficient test coverage

changesApplied.changeMade: Added type-check job that runs before build, build job now depends on type-check
changesApplied.reason: Docker images only built if code passes type checking, prevents deployment of broken code
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: HIGH - Blocks production deployments with type errors
changesApplied.diffSummary: +19 lines: new type-check job, +1 dependency: needs: type-check
changesApplied.jobDependency: build waits for type-check to succeed

changesApplied.changeMade: Created comprehensive test suite with 80%+ coverage for all 8 learning_loop endpoints
changesApplied.reason: Tests validate async/await correctness and prevent regressions (3 bugs occurred without tests)
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: CRITICAL - Provides regression protection for routes with 3 production bugs in 4 days

testCoverage.asyncFunctionsTested: All async DB calls properly awaited in tests

testCategories: Happy path: Valid requests with expected responses
Error cases: Invalid inputs, missing data, DB failures
Edge cases: Empty results, boundary conditions
Async/await: Verifies all async operations properly awaited

before.entry: Developer writes async function → Commits without type check
before.transform: Pre-commit runs black/isort → NO TYPE VALIDATION
before.validate: CI runs tests → NO COVERAGE THRESHOLD → NO TYPE CHECKING
before.exit: Bug reaches production → Runtime error (ResponseValidationError, coroutine not awaited)

after.transform: Pre-commit runs black/isort/pyright → TYPE VALIDATION (reportUnawaited: error)
after.validate: CI runs pyright → Tests → Coverage check (--cov-fail-under=80)
after.exit: Build job waits for type-check → Docker images built only if types valid
after.bugPath: Code → Commit (BLOCKED by pyright) → CI (BLOCKED by type-check + coverage) → Production (PROTECTED)

qualityGatesAdded.enforcement: Blocks commits with missing await calls
Fails PR if type errors exist
